verdicts.verify_by: cp tests/b2-lines-removed-reach-catalog-front-matter_test.go gno.land/pkg/gnoweb/zz_front_matter_r3_test.go && go test ./gno.land/pkg/gnoweb -run 'TestZZR3LowercaseProseServed|TestZZR3FrontMatter/lowercase' -v: expect the heading and the note in the body, observe welcome=false note=false
verdicts.tldr: A static page opening with a thematic break and holding a lowercase 'word: text' line before a second break loses everything between the two rules, its heading included.
verdicts.details: NewStaticAlias treats any block between a leading '---' and the next '---' as front matter once one line passes isKey && isFrontMatterKey (line 49), and skips '# Heading' lines as YAML comments (line 52), so 'note: the testnet resets weekly.' qualifies the block and target.Value becomes only the text after the second rule. The operator's page silently loses its H1 and prose, and the title falls back to the path. At the merge base cmd/gnoweb/main.go:393 stored the file verbatim, so the diff introduces the loss; it is the class gfanton raised twice and the narrowing since does not cover a lowercase key-shaped line. Fix: accept the block as front matter only when every key is a known one (title, description), or reject a block whose first line after the fence is blank.
verdicts.evidence: Head ea1c620f7, scratch worktree, finder's test: TestZZR3FrontMatter/lowercase logs 'title="" description="" body="More.\n"' --- FAIL; TestZZR3LowercaseProseServed logs '<title>about - gno.land</title>', 'status=200 welcome=false note=false more=true' --- FAIL. Read of alias_static.go:42-75 matches the mechanism. Base main.go:393 'aliases[parts[0]] = gnoweb.AliasTarget{Value: string(content), Kind: gnoweb.StaticMarkdown}'.

verdicts.verify_by: cp reviews/pr/6xxx/6229-give-every-page-title/3-ea1c620f7/tests/b3-lines-removed-reach-catalog-canonical-siblings_test.go gno.land/pkg/gnoweb/zz_b3r3_test.go && go test ./gno.land/pkg/gnoweb -run TestB3R3_FallbackViewsKeepArgs -v -count=1: expect the args variant's canonical to equal the bare one, observe a self-canonical keeping the args
verdicts.tldr: Args variants of a realm with no Render and of a namespace listing are index, follow and name themselves canonical, so one listing is published under unbounded URLs.
verdicts.details: canonicalURL clears Args only when the URL itself shows a source view, file, dir, user or pure package (line 1440); a realm without Render falls back to GetDirectoryView (handler_http.go:601-603) and a namespace with no realm to GetPathsListView (607), neither reads the args, yet the canonical keeps them. Official namespaces get this in every index mode, community ones under all. At the base no canonical was set at all and robots was a fixed 'index, follow', so the duplicate indexing predates the diff, but the diff sweeps this class (round 2's args fix) and misses these two members. Fix: clear Args in canonicalURL once the served view is known to be a directory or paths listing, e.g. by passing the resolved view kind from fetchRealm.
verdicts.evidence: Head ea1c620f7, go test -run TestB3R3_FallbackViewsKeepArgs: '/r/gnoland/norender:anything-at-all status=200 robots="index, follow" canonical="https://gno.land/r/gnoland/norender:anything-at-all"'; '/r/gnoland:anything-at-all status=200 robots="index, follow" canonical="https://gno.land/r/gnoland:anything-at-all"'; under all also '/r/nym/norender:anything-at-all ... index, follow ... self canonical'; registered: nym variant 'noindex, nofollow'. --- FAIL. Base head.html:42 '<meta name="robots" content="index, follow" />' and no Canonical assignment in base gnoweb.

verdicts.verify_by: same file copied in, go test ./gno.land/pkg/gnoweb -run TestB3R3_RealmAliasDottedKey -v -count=1: expect canonical https://gno.land/license.md, observe https://gno.land//license.md | cp tests/b5-lines-removed-reach-catalog-policy_test.go gno.land/pkg/gnoweb/zz_b5_test.go && go test ./gno.land/pkg/gnoweb -run TestB5_RealmAliasNamedLikeAFile -v -count=1
verdicts.tldr: A realm alias keyed like a file, /license.md or /Terms, publishes canonical and og:url https://gno.land//license.md, which answers 400.
verdicts.details: The round-2 fix builds the classified URL from requested.Path only when staticPage (handler_http.go:307-309); the realmAlias branch at 328-331 still calls weburl.ParseFromURL(&requested), which reads 'license.md' as File under Path '/', and canonicalURL encodes it as '//license.md'. Shared links and the canonical chain from the target page end at a 400, and the title degrades to the bare 'gno.land'. The base set no canonical, so the diff introduces it; it needs an operator alias with a dot or capital, which -aliases accepts. Fix: build sp.url for a realm alias the same way as for a static one, from requested.Path with the query, not ParseFromURL.
verdicts.evidence: Head ea1c620f7, go test -run TestB3R3_RealmAliasDottedKey: '/license.md status=200 robots="index, follow" canonical="https://gno.land//license.md" og:url="https://gno.land//license.md" title="gno.land"'; '/Terms ... canonical="https://gno.land//Terms"'; '//license.md status=400 ... title="Invalid path - gno.land"'; '/about ... canonical="https://gno.land/about"'. --- FAIL. Read of handler_http.go:304-338 shows only the staticPage branch uses requested.Path.

verdicts.verify_by: same file copied in, go test ./gno.land/pkg/gnoweb -run TestB3R3_ViewAliasTakesRealmCanonical -v -count=1: expect /r/gnoland/pages canonical https://gno.land/r/gnoland/pages, observe https://gno.land/src | go test ./gno.land/pkg/gnoweb -run TestB5_ViewAliasTakesRealmCanonical -v -count=1 with the artifact copied in
verdicts.tldr: An operator alias to a realm's $source or $help view becomes the canonical of the bare realm page, telling search engines to replace the rendered realm with the source view or a noindex page.
verdicts.details: aliasTargets keys each GnowebPath alias by aliasKey, which encodes only EncodePath|EncodeArgs (page_kind.go:77,89-91), so '/r/gnoland/pages$source' is stored under '/r/gnoland/pages'; aliasFor then matches the bare realm URL, which has no WebQuery, and canonicalURL returns the alias. With '/actions=/r/gnoland/home$help', /r/gnoland/home names /actions canonical while /actions answers noindex, follow. aliasFor is new in this diff and the base set no canonical. Fix: skip in aliasTargets any target whose WebQuery is non-empty, or include the view in the key.
verdicts.evidence: Head ea1c620f7, go test -run TestB3R3_ViewAliasTakesRealmCanonical: '/r/gnoland/pages status=200 robots="index, follow" canonical="https://gno.land/src" og:url="https://gno.land/src"'; '/r/gnoland/home ... canonical="https://gno.land/actions"'; '/actions status=200 robots="noindex, follow" canonical=""'. --- FAIL. Read of page_kind.go:74-99 confirms the key drops WebQuery. DefaultAliases (app.go:19-31) has no $ target, so it needs operator config.
